claim_boundary: This proves an exact edge/local-packet compatibility calculus and typed nonjoin partition. It does not lower-bound overlap for actual populations or prove a recurrence, skeleton, density, or interval gain.

exact_replay.boundary: This is an exact compatibility calculus. It does not lower-bound overlap for actual edge and packet populations or prove a recurrence, skeleton, density, or interval result.
exact_replay.composition: a compatible target edge seeds the local packet and realizes the Cycle-67 progression at strip constant C_edge+C_packet
exact_replay.loop: a same-label direct affine loop has trivial integer holonomy; it does not create a nonzero local packet step
exact_replay.overlap: the exact join count is the bipartite form sum_(e,p) weight(e)*weight(p)*1_Comp(e,p), not a product of global masses or a diagonal common-key product
exact_replay.separation: target-label, target-range, packet-admissibility, subcritical-depth, and strip-constant failures are an exhaustive ordered partition for this join interface
